name: Dust Storm
body:
School conjuration (creation)[earth]; Level bard 2, druid 2, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of dust)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. +5 ft./2 levels)
Area 20‑ft.‑radius‑spread
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A swirling mass of thick dust spreads out from the point you designate. This dust severely limits visibility, creates a constant droning noise, and blocks scent, granting concealment against all senses (including special senses such as tremorsense) for anything entirely within its area (but not to Large or bigger creatures and objects only partially within the spell’s area). Creatures with concealment gain a 20% miss chance against successful attacks and can make Stealth checks, as outlined in the normal rules for concealment. This spell cannot be negated by high winds, and is fully functional underwater.

You may choose to double the spell’s radius when cast, at the cost of reducing its duration to one round/2 levels.
